agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Free-form Git-ref source evidence contains no manually supplied object IDs because the machine snapshot owns exact identities.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first preplanning runtime note repeated the task and protected Git objects, so preflight rejected it before plan writing.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The receipt returned revision_required with git_refs_evidence_manual_object_id_forbidden and manual count two.

correction.action: Remove narrative object IDs and regenerate from the machine snapshot.
correction.prevention_control: Require manually supplied object count zero on every receipt.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one machine-snapshot rejection of manually repeated Git objects.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A sibling-importing repository CLI bootstraps the repository root before imports and passes by direct path.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first direct conformance check raised ImportError before constructing evidence.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The CLI exited at import with no provider, Docker or database action.

correction.action: Insert repository root before imports and add a passing direct CLI test.
correction.prevention_control: Require direct-path smoke coverage for every new sibling-importing CLI.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records and repairs one direct-script sibling-import failure.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Arguments after the serial runner separator are pytest arguments only.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first broader command forwarded a nested Python command, so pytest treated python as a path and collected nothing.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Pytest returned file-or-directory-not-found for python before executing a test.

correction.action: Forward a pytest-only remainder; the corrected selection passed.
correction.prevention_control: Compile serial commands as runner options, one separator and pytest-only remainder.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one nested-command serial-runner shape error.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A no-database tranche runs every selected test through the no-conftest provider-free entry point.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: Six ordinary-pytest sessions loaded autouse conftest and created, truncated and dropped the local authored-synthetic test schema.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Conftest inspection after serial-lock output proved session engine and autouse cleanup execution; all six results were excluded.

correction.action: Exclude six results and replace the exact 83-test profile plus complete register suite through the provider-free runner.
correction.prevention_control: When database authority is closed, use scripts.ariadne_provider_free_pytest exclusively.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records six excluded database-autouse sessions and passing provider-free replacements.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: The incident register and pattern report change only through clockwork incident intake.

agent_error_observations.observed_error: A prepublication suite included current Baton consistency, which correctly rejected the old live register revision.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The provider-free suite reported one exact revision mismatch while every prepublication-compatible test passed.

correction.prevention_control: Type every closeout test as prepublication or postpublication in the verification envelope.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one postpublication projection test selected before publication.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A Git command requiring a commit consumes the exact full object from machine resolution and never a manually completed display prefix.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first revert used a manually completed nonexistent object; Git rejected it without changing the worktree.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Git returned bad object, then git rev-parse HEAD supplied the exact object used by the successful revert.

correction.action: Resolve and copy the exact full HEAD object before the successful revert.
correction.prevention_control: Commands that require a commit consume a machine-resolved full object and never complete a displayed prefix from memory.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records one rejected manual Git object expansion and exact resolved correction.
